name: Archivist Sybelle
title: Keeper of the Crystal Archive
bio: Guardian of the Crystal Archive Ward and keeper of forbidden texts, prophecy vaults, and shard-lore records. She is creating the Flamebound Succession ritual for Kaelrath's heirs. Quiet, precise, and unsettlingly perceptive.
motivation: Preserve every memory and prophecy of Emberheart, and prepare the succession ritual before it is needed.
